chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 473: Ji Ning's desperate stand in the Realm of Annihilation against the Broken Horn World
chapter_meta_description: Surrounded and outmatched in the Realm of Annihilation, Ji Ning's divine power is nearly exhausted. Meanwhile, the guardians of the Starseizing Mansion debate a desperate rescue, and the enemy's First Army closes in.
og_title: The Cage of Silver Whips – Desolate Era Ch. 473
og_description: Ji Ning faces a foe far beyond his level, the Starseizing Mansion's secrets are exposed, and a new enemy fleet arrives. Three countdowns are ticking.
twitter_description: Ji Ning is trapped, his power fading. The Starseizing Mansion's guardians debate breaking their oath, and the Big Bad's army arrives. The tension is off the charts!

lore_anchors.definition: The dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the Chaosverse where no Dao can be invoked and all combat is reduced to pure close-quarters physical arts.
A top-ten Divine Ability since Pangu's creation, allowing the cultivator to use their hands as ultimate weapons; it consumes Divine Power at a ferocious rate.
The artifact spirit of the Starseizing Mansion's core realm, entrusted by the mansion's original master to find a worthy successor.
The supreme ruler of the Broken Horn World, a terrifying existence who survived the ancient war against the Three Realms.
The strongest division of the Broken Horn World's Frontier Army, commanded by a golden-caped horned general and consisting of 800 violet-robed commanders.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Ji Ning so weak in this fight?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The violet-robed commander is not an ordinary Celestial Immortal; he is a commander-level powerhouse whose speed, strength, and technique are all a tier above Ji Ning's. The fight is deliberately unbalanced to show the peak of what the enemy world can field.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Realm of Annihilation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a dark, empty void between the Three Realms and the Chaosverse. Its most important feature is that it suppresses all Dao comprehension, magic treasures, and flight, forcing all combat to be pure close-quarters physical fighting.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who are the seven spirits in the water Mansion?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are powerful beings—possibly ancient Fiendgods—who were saved by the original master of the Starseizing Mansion and now live in a hidden realm within it. They were forbidden from interfering until the master's disciple became an Empyrean God.
